cards.title: PT-symmetric Schrodinger eigenproblem and origin patch
cards.role: exact spectrum for all numerical targets

source_refs.value: raw/paper.pdf pp. 1-3, Eqs. (1)-(2) and numerical-method paragraph

cards.numerical_form: sparse contour eigenproblem plus independent Riccati patching

checks.reason: Hamiltonian and boundary-value problem are printed explicitly.
PT symmetry makes psi(0) real and psi'(0) purely imaginary for a real eigenvalue.

cards.title: Anti-Stokes wedge centers and smooth contour
cards.numerical_form: smooth PT-symmetric contour with analytic first and second derivatives

checks.reason: Both wedge centers and their opening are printed.
At N=2 the contour reduces to the real axis.

open_questions: The authors do not print their finite endpoint radius or contour interpolation near the origin.

cards.role: Table I WKB columns and spectrum trend

source_refs.value: raw/paper.pdf p. 3, Eqs. (4)-(5) and Table I

cards.numerical_form: direct log-gamma evaluation plus an explicit turning-point segment / principal-branch-cut intersection test

checks.reason: The formula and target table are printed.
N=2 reduces to E_n=2n+1.

cards.title: Riccati shooting patch condition
cards.role: exact Table II energies and near-one Fig. 1 branch

source_refs.value: raw/paper.pdf pp. 2-4, patching discussion and Runge-Kutta method

cards.numerical_form: adaptive DOP853 integration and bracketed scalar root

checks.reason: The paper prints the origin patch condition and states that its primary solver integrates the coupled real equations with Runge-Kutta.
Substitution y=psi'/psi gives the Riccati equation exactly.
The selected square-root branch yields exponential decay at positive infinity.

source_refs.value: raw/paper.pdf p. 4, Eq. (11) and Table II

checks.reason: Equation, epsilon grid and comparison column are printed.
The positive root grows as epsilon decreases and reproduces the printed asymptotic column to its four-digit precision.

cards.title: Massive N=1 shifted oscillator
cards.role: analytic anchor for all Fig. 3 families

checks.reason: Complex coordinate translation leaves the oscillator level spacing and adds 1/(4m^2).
Eq. (1) supplies the massive Hamiltonian and Fig. 3 prints m^2=3/16,5/16,7/16.

cards.title: Exactly solvable shifted-oscillator sequences
cards.role: opening PT and non-PT spectral examples
derived_from: analytic continuation of the oscillator contour
cards.numerical_form: closed-form spectra for b=0, i, -1, and -1+i

checks.reason: The paper explicitly prints the four Hamiltonians and their energy sequences.
Completing the square gives the constant spectral shift -b^2/4 without using author data.

cards.title: N=1 Airy matching obstruction
cards.role: absence of a real eigenvalue at the spectral transition
cards.numerical_form: independent complex Airy evaluation over five real energies

checks.reason: The Airy solution, matching condition, and constant derivative are printed in Eqs. (6)-(7).
The Airy Wronskian fixes the derivative to -1/(2 pi), so it cannot vanish for real E.

cards.title: Classical period and subcritical spiral geometry
cards.role: classical transition accompanying the quantum spectral transition

source_refs.value: raw/paper.pdf p. 4, Eq. (12) and following text

cards.numerical_form: log-gamma period plus unwrapped Riemann-sheet Hamiltonian integration, turning-point passage events, and quantum-merger / classical-passage correspondence

checks.reason: Eq. (12), the N>=2 periodicity statement, and the N<2 spiral discussion are printed explicitly.
At N=2 and E=1 the formula reduces to the harmonic period pi in the paper's normalization.

cards.title: Hermitian absolute-power spectrum and square-well limit

source_refs.value: raw/paper.pdf p. 3, paragraph following Table I

derived_from: Dirichlet spectrum on the limiting interval [-1,1]
cards.numerical_form: log-gamma WKB comparator plus independent sparse real-axis finite differences

checks.reason: The missing sine factor and square-well limiting spectrum are both printed explicitly.
The independent |x|^N eigenspectrum converges toward (n+1)^2 pi^2/4 through N=512.

cards.title: Near-one logarithmic scaling law
cards.role: body-level asymptotic claim in the Table II caption

source_refs.value: raw/paper.pdf p. 4, Eq. (11) and Table II caption

derived_from: dominant balance of 4E^(3/2)/3 against -ln epsilon in Eq. (11)
cards.numerical_form: log-domain Eq. (11) roots and a log-log slope against -ln epsilon

checks.reason: The two-thirds scaling is printed explicitly in the Table II caption.
The fitted slope on epsilon=10^-40..10^-200 is within 0.02 of 2/3.

cards.title: Near-N=2 non-Hermitian two-level merger
cards.role: body-level explanation of high-energy-first exceptional-point mergers

source_refs.value: raw/paper.pdf p. 4, Behavior near N=2 paragraph

cards.numerical_form: Gauss-Hermite matrix elements and the positive zero of the two-level discriminant

checks.reason: The paper prints the first-order perturbation and states that adjacent levels merge rather than repel.
The odd imaginary coupling enters the complex-symmetric discriminant with a negative square, allowing coalescence.
Independent 192- and 256-node quadratures agree and the merger epsilon decreases monotonically through level 20.

open_questions: The paper refers the full asymptotic merger calculation to another work, so the present check tests the printed first-order mechanism rather than reconstructing unpublished higher orders.

cards.numerical_form: closed-form anchors cross-checked by independent real-axis finite differences
